content:
Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a leading innovator in the field of chemical new materials, headquartered at No. 136 Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. Strategically located in one of China’s most dynamic economic and technological hubs, the company leverages Hangzhou’s strong industrial infrastructure and proximity to top-tier research institutions to drive innovation and sustainable development in the chemical sector. Established with a vision to become a benchmark in high-performance chemical materials, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of advanced chemical products, including specialty polymers, functional additives, eco-friendly solvents, and new composite materials that cater to a wide array of industries such as electronics, automotive, pharmaceuticals, construction, and green energy.

Committed to scientific advancement and environmental responsibility, the company integrates cutting-edge technologies with rigorous quality control systems, ensuring products meet both domestic and international standards. Zhejiang Runhe Chemical operates state-of-the-art production facilities equipped with automated control systems and adheres to strict safety and environmental protocols, complying with ISO and other global certifications. The company maintains a strong R&D team dedicated to product innovation and process optimization, often collaborating with universities and research organizations to stay at the forefront of material science.

With a customer-centric approach and a focus on sustainable growth, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. continues to expand its market reach across Asia, Europe, and North America, building trusted partnerships through reliability, technical excellence, and environmentally conscious solutions.
